history.content: took my name badge off at work today. the old one. they finally reprinted it
That old badge coming off feels like a small but real marker of change. I'm here if you want to stay with what that moment was like, or leave it there for now.
yeah. it has my actual name on it now. not the one i was hired under
"My actual name" on it now feels like the centre of this. That sounds important.
took 3 years. forms, hr, two managers who kept forgetting. and today it was just. there. printed right
It sounds like something eased into place at last, after a long, tedious wait. Did it land more as settled relief, or as a quiet kind of satisfaction?
settled i think. i didnt cry or anything. just held it and my shoulders kind of dropped
That drop in your shoulders feels like the clearest sign of it, settled and finally real in your hands. Is there a little more to notice in the body, or is that enough for now?
its weird how a piece of plastic does that. like the company finally sees me as me. not the old paperwork version
"Sees me as me" feels like the center of it, not just the plastic. I’m learning this calm came with being recognised, after a long stretch of being the paperwork version.
i stopped expecting it tbh. got used to correcting people, or just letting it slide. easier to not hope
That sounds like a kind of guardedness, maybe protecting you from being let down again. Do you want to stay with that piece, or leave it here for now?
yeah maybe. but today the guard kind of. wasnt needed. i could just have the good thing. thats the part that feels new
That newness matters, the guard could step back and you could just receive it. I’m wondering if it also touched the older part that had learned not to hope?
it did. like the old me that gave up gets to be a bit wrong for once. in a good way. i dunno. i just feel ok. quiet ok

Quiet ok has a gentle shape here, and the old part that gave up gets a small correction without having to fight for it. We can leave it there, or stay with what this kind of “a bit wrong for once” means to you.
lets leave it there. thanks for this. needed to put it somewhere. gonna go look at the badge again lol
Of course, and I’m glad it had a place to land. Enjoy looking at the badge again, lol.
